messages:
sophia_cs: Heads up — Arcadia Health (cust_8472) flagged invoice INV-2026-0192, huge overage ($8,900). Looks like ingestion doubled during 2026-03-15 02:00-03:00 UTC. Can finance review for a goodwill/manual credit?

matt_fin: Thanks — can you paste any logs or a quick query showing the duplicated events? need the exact window + sample IDs for audit.

sophia_cs: sure — pulled this from metrics, short snippet:```sql
SELECT event_id, count(*) as hits
FROM ingestion_events
WHERE customer_id='cust_8472' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-15T02:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-15T03:00:00Z'
GROUP BY event_id
HAVING hits > 1
LIMIT 5;```
results show ~12k dup events, likely caused the spike. ticket #CS-2149 created with full export: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-2149

kevin_ops: I dug in — upstream vendor webhook retried on 02:12 due to transient 5xx, but our retry dedupe failed for ~3m because the `idempotency_key` header was missing in the vendor payload. Confirmed via logs: `vendor-webhook-processor` 02:12:05-02:15:20. Not a customer-side retry.

kevin_ops: repro evidence:```
vendor-webhook-processor ERROR at 2026-03-15T02:12:07Z: missing idempotency header for req 0x7a2b
...
```

matt_fin: Got it. So this is platform-side (vendor integration) error -> recommend full refund for the duplicated tokens. What's the amount to credit?

sophia_cs: Invoice shows overage charge $8,900. Based on usage breakdown, duplicates account for ~$8,200; propose crediting $8,200 as an invoice adjustment + additional $500 goodwill promo for the customer success touch. Total credit $8,700.

matt_fin: Please provide GL code for the adjustment and confirm approval from finance lead. I'll queue a manual credit once approved. Recommended GL: `4500-COGS-credits`.

sophia_cs: GL confirmed. Adding request for approval: @emma_cfo can you sign off?

emma_cfo: Reviewed the evidence and ticket. Approve goodwill/manual credit up to $9k for Arcadia Health — please proceed. :white_check_mark:

matt_fin: Thanks @emma_cfo. Processing manual credit now. Will apply as a negative line on INV-2026-0192 and issue a credit memo.

billing-bot: Automated update: Manual credit created.
- credit_id: CR-2026-3345
- amount: $8,700
- applied_to: INV-2026-0192
- status: PENDING_REVIEW

matt_fin: Done — credit queued and routed to accounting for posting. Posting ETA EOD. I added note: "reason: duplicated ingestion due to vendor webhook retries, CS ticket CS-2149".

sophia_cs: Really appreciate the quick turnaround — I told the customer we'll refund the overage and add a goodwill promo. I'll keep them updated. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: Update: CR-2026-3345 status changed -> POSTED. Transaction ref: tx_9f3c2b. Link to credit memo PDF: https://billing.redwood.com/credits/CR-2026-3345.pdf
